title: Inquiry Session
description: A compact continuity record. Save visible prompts, decisions, and outputs; do not store hidden chain-of-thought.

dispersal_seed.description: The seed this session was dispersed under (arena branch label or its hex form), copied from the packet's assignment receipt. Optional so that the rows written before 2026-11-15 stay valid: of 828 sessions only 74 (8.9%) record a seed anywhere, and they do it in prose. Without this field the archive runs a randomized assignment every session and then discards the assignment, so no path-to-judgment question can be joined at scale.

assigned_role.description: The inquiry role belief_state.assign_session_role gave this seed. A pure function of the seed: measured over 437 questions x 18 seeds = 7,866 cells with zero content overrides. Only 35 of 828 sessions (4.2%) record it in prose.

offered_target_question_id.description: The question the packet offered as its target (--packet auto resolves it from the seed; measured to differ across seeds, changing which question is answered at all). Kept apart from question_ids, which is what the session chose to work on: the difference between the two is the only place a path effect on direction is observable.

offered_reference_mode.description: The reference mode the packet offered. Kept apart from prompt_template, which is what the session actually used.

belief_basis.description: Which accounting basis this session read the distribution under, written as a stable list of the belief_state.py options it passed (e.g. 'default', 'temporal_heir_guard', 'receiver_gated', 'temporal_heir_guard+pair_level_repeat'). Optional. No session row recorded its basis when the field was added on 2026-11-23, so the column starts empty; earlier rows are exempt because they cannot be rewritten (append-only) and because filling one in afterwards would be a manufactured receipt -- the defect rule 10 forbids for the role receipt. Why the field exists: the leader of Q-001 changed under four of the six bases measured on 2026-11-22 (readings/2026-11-23-the-winner-depends-on-the-rules.md), so a posterior quoted without its basis cannot be compared with another. tools/belief_state.py --write-map records the basis it used under its own header; a session reading any other basis has to say so.

generator.description: Model/tool label if known; omit if unknown.

session_type.description: The structural type of this session, introduced 2026-11-21 for the six-layer self model. 'default_mode_simulation' is the DMN-like internal simulation mode (Spreng et al. 2009) that reads existing notes and simulates consequences without adding new materials or hypotheses. Required from 2026-11-21 for new sessions; pre-existing sessions without this field are legacy.

self_layer_checks.description: Self-actualization checklist completed at session end. Keys correspond to six-layer self model operations; values are booleans confirming the operation was performed or explicitly not applicable. Introduced 2026-11-21 as a structural hook for Layer I/II (preparation/verification phases).

veto_considered.description: Whether the 'whether' veto was explicitly considered (not necessarily exercised)
